AI.title: [AINews] Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1: new SOTA model, 75% cache price cut…
AI.what: Anthropic released Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1 with SOTA performance, a 75% cache price cut, and 70% higher output tokens.
AI.why: Massive price reduction on prompt caching combined with higher output makes complex agent loops significantly cheaper.
AI.impact: Reduces token costs for building autonomous agents.

AI.title: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention
AI.what: New research demonstrates that language models can actively control their own attention mechanisms over the KV cache.
AI.why: This bypasses the need to scan full long contexts for every single token, drastically speeding up retrieval.
AI.impact: Improves latency for long-context voice agents.

AI.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
AI.what: ATV Big Air Tour used ChatGPT Work to build an inventory website from merchandise photos in just 15 minutes.
AI.why: Demonstrates rapid, non-developer prototyping and workflow automation using standard enterprise AI tools.
AI.impact: Speeds up prototyping and no-code product iteration.

Design.title: Claude Code’s New Design Plugin Is a Big Deal for Product Designers
Design.what: Claude Code released a new design plugin enabling direct design creation within the tool.
Design.why: It bridges coding and designing for solo builders without relying on traditional design handoffs.

Design.title: When the canvas starts acting, who’s really in control?
Design.what: UX Collective explored how agentic canvas interfaces shift control from interaction to agency.
Design.why: It redefines UX patterns for multi-tool context aggregation and autonomous execution.

Design.title: Making kyōwa possible with AI
Design.what: UX Collective published an exploration on unbundling the Send button using AI as sketches.
Design.why: It offers new conversational interaction patterns beyond traditional chat interfaces.

Voice AI.title: Ashley Kramer joins ElevenLabs as Chief Revenue Officer
Voice AI.what: Ashley Kramer has joined ElevenLabs as their new Chief Revenue Officer.
Voice AI.why: It signals major enterprise scaling for a key voice AI tool provider.
Voice AI.impact: Potential shifts in pricing and enterprise tool availability
